description: This Java class 'NoteController' is a REST controller exposing CRUD operations for notes in a web application. It handles HTTP requests related to notes, such as listing all notes, retrieving a specific note by ID, creating, updating, and deleting notes. The class uses Spring Boot annotations to define endpoints and Swagger annotations for API documentation.

classes.name: NoteController
classes.description: Controller class managing REST API endpoints for notes.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Returns a list of all notes by mapping Note entities to NoteResponse DTOs.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a single note by its ID and maps it to NoteResponse DTO.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new note from the provided NoteRequest DTO and returns the created NoteResponse.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing note specified by ID with data from NoteRequest DTO.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a note by its ID.

methods.name: map
methods.description: Helper method to convert Note entity to NoteResponse DTO.
